nodes.name: Hexapod EDTA-NMF Synthesis
nodes.procedure: Solution A was prepared by dissolving 0.147 g of manganese (II) acetate tetrahydrate (MnAc2·4H2O) in 10 mL ethylenediaminetetraacetic acid disodium salt dihydrate (Na2EDTA·2H2O) solution (0.075 mol/L). Then, 0.291 g of sodium hexacyanoferrate(II) decahydrate (Na4Fe(CN)6·10H2O) was dissolved in 15 mL deionized (DI) water to form solution B. Subsequently, solution B was added into solution A in 7 s with constant stirring. After continuous stirring for 30 s, the obtained white mixed solution was aged at room temperature (25°C) for 60 h. The resultant white precipitate was collected by centrifugation, washed with DI water and ethanol several times, and then finally dried under vacuum at 100°C for 12 h.

nodes.name: NaTi2(PO4)3 Synthesis
nodes.procedure: 0.164 g sodium acetate and 0.68 g titanium(IV) butoxide were dissolved into 6 mL of H3PO4 solution (85 wt %) and 40 mL of ethanol, respectively. The two solutions were mixed with constant stirring and then transferred into 100 mL Teflon-lined autoclave for reaction for 3 h at 160°C. The resultant white precipitate was collected by centrifugation and washed with ethanol several times. Finally, the obtained powder was annealing at 600°C for 2 h in argon.

nodes.characterization_summary: ICP-AES reveals Cit-NMF bulk atomic ratio Na/Mn/Fe = 2.04/1.14/1 (Table S1) indicating 17.3% V_FeCN; EDTA-NMF (0.075 mol/L, 60h) bulk ratio Na/Mn/Fe = 1.60/1.02/1.
nodes.evidence_snippet: ICP-AES showed a higher ratio of Mn/Fe (1.21:1), suggesting 17.3% V_FeCN in the interior of NMF (Table S1)... The chemical formula of EDTA-NMF at the surface is calculated as Na1.6Mn0.75(□Mn)0.25[Fe(CN)6]•1.57H2O at 0.075 mol L⁻¹.

nodes.characterization_summary: XRD Rietveld refinement shows both Cit-NMF and EDTA-NMF have well-crystallized monoclinic structure P21/n symmetry; EDTA-NMF lattice parameters slightly decreased compared to Cit-NMF.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The X-ray diffraction (XRD) patterns of the two NMFs (Figures 1C and 1D) demonstrate the well-crystallized diffraction peaks of the monoclinic structure with P21/n symmetry, suggesting that EDTA-NMF is well maintained in the monoclinic phase after V_Mn introduction.

nodes.characterization_summary: XPS surface analysis shows EDTA-NMF Mn 3s splitting energy ΔE=6.0/5.5 eV indicating Mn closer to Mn²⁺; proportion of Mn³⁺ decreases as Na₂EDTA concentration or reaction time increases (Figures S9, S13).
nodes.evidence_snippet: The splitting energy (ΔE = 6.0 eV and 5.5 eV) in the Cit-NMF is assigned to the Mn²⁺ and Mn³⁺... It can be inferred from the Figure S9A the proportion of Mn³⁺ gradually decreases with the increasing the concentrations of Na₂EDTA.

nodes.characterization_summary: FTIR shows peak at 2029 cm⁻¹ in EDTA-NMF attributed to Mn vacancy effect on C≡N vibration; peak intensity increases with V_Mn content.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The formation of V_Mn could be confirmed by Fourier-transform infrared (FTIR) spectra (Figure S7). Generally, the peak around 2,100 cm⁻¹ is attributed to the vibration of C≡N bonds... a weak red-shifted peak appeared at 2,029 cm⁻¹ in EDTA-NMF.

nodes.characterization_summary: ESR shows g-factor=2.015 for EDTA-NMF indicating Mn2+ unpaired electrons; signal intensity increases with V_Mn content.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Electron spin resonance (ESR) spectra can also verify the changes in vacancy type (Figure S8). ... in the presence of Na2EDTA, the center of the Lorentzian line moved to g-factor=2.015.

nodes.characterization_summary: Nitrogen adsorption-desorption BET analysis shows specific surface area increases from 11.7 m²/g (before etching) to 15.3 m²/g (hexapod EDTA-NMF after 60h etching).
nodes.evidence_snippet: Specific surface areas were measured at -196°C through Brunauer-Emmett-Teller nitrogen adsorption-desorption method... After etching, the specific surface area increased from 11.7 to 15.3 m² g⁻¹ (Figure S12).

nodes.characterization_summary: SEM shows Cit-NMF as ~500 nm cubes; EDTA-NMF forms hexapod structures 500-700 nm after 60h etching.
nodes.evidence_snippet: After reaction for 60 h, the EDTA-NMF cubes became hexapod-like structures with dimensions of 500-700 nm.

nodes.characterization_summary: HAADF-STEM and EDS mappings show uniform distribution of Mn, Fe, Na, N elements in hexapod EDTA-NMF.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The energy-dispersive XPS mappings clearly exhibited the uniform distribution of Mn, Fe, Na, and N elements in the hexapod EDTA-NMF (Figures 2B–2F).
